en_title: Destin Daniel Cretton Admits He Was 'Sad' When Avengers: Kang Dynasty Got Canceled
cn_title: 《康之王朝》取消，导演坦言难过
subtitle: 一度担心关系生变
opus_summary: Cretton称，《复仇者联盟：康之王朝》因Jonathan Majors法律问题取消，令他失落，也担心与费奇关系受影响。随后，他接下《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》。

paragraphs.en: The Spider-Man: Brand New Day director admitted to feeling disappointed when Marvel’s carefully-crafted buildup to Kang the Conqueror didn’t pan out as originally planned.
paragraphs.cn: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》导演Destin Daniel Cretton承认，漫威精心铺陈的征服者康剧情线未能按原计划发展，这让他感到失望。

paragraphs.en: Cretton, best known for his work on Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings , was all set to direct Avengers: The Kang Dynasty, first announced back in 2022. That all fell apart after Jonathan Majors, cast as the aforementioned Kang, got the boot due to his legal troubles, and Dr Doom was revealed as the next big baddie of the MCU.
paragraphs.cn: Cretton最为人熟知的作品是《尚气与十环传奇》。他原本将执导2022年首次公布的《复仇者联盟：康之王朝》。随后，饰演上述康的Jonathan Majors因法律麻烦被解雇，该计划也随之告吹；毁灭博士则被揭晓为MCU的下一位大反派。

paragraphs.en: In a July 2026 interview with IndieWire , Cretton was asked about his feelings on the subject, with interviewer Mike Ryan asking if he was "disappointed" at the time.
paragraphs.cn: 在2026年7月接受IndieWire采访时，Cretton被问到自己对此有何感受，记者Mike Ryan问他当时是否「感到失望」。

paragraphs.en: “I was feeling exactly that,” Cretton confirmed. “I mean, it was a weird time in the industry, altogether. We were on strike. The whole time during the strike, I was wondering if this thing was going to happen. When that wound up falling through… yeah, I was sad. I try not to hang my emotions too much about circumstances outside of my control. When Kevin [Feige] asked me if I’d be interested in Spidey, I became very happy.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我的感受正是如此。」Cretton确认道，「我是说，当时整个行业都处在一个奇怪的时期。我们正在罢工。罢工期间，我一直在想这件事到底会不会发生。后来这事没成……是的，我很难过。我尽量不让那些不受我控制的情况过多影响自己的情绪。凯文·费奇问我是否有意接手《蜘蛛侠》时，我非常开心。」

paragraphs.en: Marvel President Kevin Feige’s decision to hand Cretton another big project in Brand New Day fairly quickly was a welcome surprise for the director, who admitted that he’d been anxious that his relationship with him would suffer as a result of this shift in creative direction.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威影业总裁凯文·费奇很快把《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》这个大型项目交给Cretton，这让他喜出望外。Cretton承认，由于创作方向转变，他曾担心自己与费奇的关系会受影响。

paragraphs.en: “When [Avengers: The Kang Dynasty] wasn’t going to happen, I was a little bit scared that my relationship with Kevin maybe was going to change,” he said. “But it didn’t at all. On the day that wasn’t going to work out, we were talking about what could work out. And Spidey was mentioned, but it wasn’t like an offer by any means. It took a bit before that happened. From the inside looking out, it’s not nearly as dramatic as it is from the outside looking in.”
paragraphs.cn: 「当《复仇者联盟：康之王朝》确定不会推进时，我有点害怕我和凯文的关系可能会改变。」他说，「但完全没有。那件事确定行不通的当天，我们就已经在讨论哪些事情可以行得通。有人提到了《蜘蛛侠》，但那绝对算不上邀约。过了一阵子，邀约才真的到来。从圈内往外看，这件事远没有从圈外往里看那么戏剧化。」

paragraphs.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is already projected to be a massive success at the box office, with predictions floating anywhere from $180 - $230 million and more. Reviews have skewed mostly positive, with IGN’s Tom Jorgensen giving it a 7 out of 10 .
paragraphs.cn: 外界预计《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》将在票房上大获成功，预估票房介于1.8亿美元(约合人民币12亿元)和2.3亿美元(约合人民币16亿元)之间，甚至可能更高。评论整体偏正面，IGN的Tom Jorgensen为其打出7分（满分10分）。

paragraphs.en: After this, Marvel fans will have Avengers: Doomsday to look forward to, slated to release on December 18, 2026. Not much has been teased for the film, though its massive cast has provided speculation enough. A slew of stars appearing in Doomsday showed face at San Diego Comic Con, where very little information was given aside from a short clip shown exclusively to attendees.
paragraphs.cn: 之后，漫威影迷将期待定于2026年12月18日上映的《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》。目前该片曝光的内容不多，但庞大的演员阵容已足以引发猜测。多位参演明星亮相圣迭戈国际漫画展，现场除了一段仅向与会者播放的短片外，几乎没有透露其他信息。

paragraphs.en: As per IGN’s own Eric Goldman, the clip showed Doom raising up an army of dormant Sentinels in one of the most comic-accurate scenes we’ve seen thus far in the MCU. For now, these tidbits will have to be enough for anxious fans as D23 sits on the horizon, hopefully with more information on Doomsday and the future of the X-Men.
paragraphs.cn: 据IGN的Eric Goldman介绍，那段短片呈现了毁灭博士唤醒一支休眠的哨兵机器人军队；这是迄今MCU中最贴近漫画的场景之一。眼下，焦急的影迷只能先靠这些零星信息解渴，D23已近在眼前，或许会带来更多关于《毁灭之日》以及《X战警》未来的消息。
